beginner.summary: For engineers and administrators new to Oracle Cloud. Covers tenancies, regions and availability domains, compartments, IAM and identity domains, virtual cloud networks, security lists and network security groups, gateways, compute, block, object and file storage, load balancers, DNS, Autonomous Database and other database services, monitoring and logging, cost management, the CLI and Terraform with Resource Manager.
prerequisites: Basic networking: IP addresses, subnets and DNS
Comfortable on the Linux command line
outcomes: Set up a tenancy with compartments, users and policies
Build networks, compute, storage and load balancers
Run Autonomous Database and other database services
Monitor, control cost and automate with the CLI and Terraform

days.topic: OCI Overview, Tenancy and Free Tier Setup
subtopics: OCI compared with AWS, Azure and Google Cloud
Signing up for the Free Tier
The course case company: a retail chain moving to OCI
days.lab_task: Create a Free Tier tenancy, explore the console, open Cloud Shell, check service limits and list which Always Free resources the course will use.
days.deliverable: Tenancy details and a resource plan
checks: Shell runs with the CLI ready
Limits for compute and storage recorded

days.topic: Regions, Availability Domains and Fault Domains
days.lab_task: Subscribe to a second region, list availability and fault domains in each and place two instances in different fault domains.
checks: Region choice for India customers justified

days.topic: Compartments, Users, Groups and Policies
subtopics: Verbs: inspect, read, use and manage
days.lab_task: Create compartments for networking, apps and databases, create admin and developer groups and write policies so developers manage instances only in the apps compartment.
checks: Create an instance as a developer
Change a network as a developer
Each grants only what is needed

days.topic: Identity Domains and Federation
subtopics: Federation with Microsoft Entra ID or Okta
days.lab_task: Federate the tenancy with an identity provider for single sign-on with MFA and create a dynamic group so instances can read object storage without keys.
checks: Login with MFA through the identity provider
Read a bucket from an instance
Works with instance principal and no keys

days.topic: Virtual Cloud Networks and Subnets
days.lab_task: Plan addressing and build a VCN with public and private subnets by hand and with the wizard, and draw the network.
checks: Public and private subnets as planned

days.topic: Security Lists and Network Security Groups
days.lab_task: Allow web traffic to a web tier and only app traffic to a database tier with NSGs, block everything else and find a blocked connection in flow logs.
days.deliverable: Security rules and flow log analysis
checks: Reach the database from the internet

days.topic: Gateways: Internet, NAT and Service Gateways
days.lab_task: Give private instances outbound internet through a NAT gateway, reach object storage through a service gateway and peer two VCNs.
checks: Update packages from a private instance

days.topic: Compute Instances
days.lab_task: Launch a flexible Ampere instance with cloud-init that installs a web server, resize it, create a custom image and launch a copy.
days.deliverable: Instances, cloud-init file and custom image

days.topic: Block Volumes and Backups
days.lab_task: Attach a block volume, mount it, grow it online, apply a backup policy, restore a backup to a new volume and copy a backup to another region.
checks: Data back on the new volume

days.topic: Object Storage
subtopics: Storage tiers: standard, infrequent access and archive
days.lab_task: Create buckets, upload files with the CLI, move old files to archive with a lifecycle policy, share a file with a pre-authenticated request and turn on versioning.
checks: File downloads without login until expiry

days.topic: File Storage
days.lab_task: Create a file system with a mount target, mount it on two instances, restrict access by subnet and restore a file from a snapshot.

days.topic: Load Balancers and Network Load Balancers
days.lab_task: Put two web servers behind a load balancer with HTTPS, health checks and path routing, stop one server and confirm traffic moves.

days.topic: DNS and Traffic Management
days.lab_task: Host a public zone, add private DNS for internal names, create a failover steering policy between two regions and test it.

days.topic: Autonomous Database
days.lab_task: Create an Autonomous Database, connect with a wallet, load data, scale it, clone it for testing and restore to a point in time.
checks: Clone available with the same data
Restore to a point in time

days.topic: Database Services: Base Database and MySQL HeatWave
days.lab_task: Create a Base Database system and a MySQL HeatWave instance, back up and patch the Base Database and compare services for three workloads.
checks: Service chosen per workload with reasons

days.topic: Monitoring, Logging and Notifications
days.lab_task: Create alarms for CPU and load balancer errors, send notifications by email, collect instance logs and find who deleted a resource in the audit log.
days.deliverable: Alarms, log settings and audit findings
checks: User and time in the audit log

days.topic: Cost Management, Budgets and Tagging
days.lab_task: Create defined tags with defaults for cost centres, set a budget with alerts, apply compartment quotas and report cost by tag.
days.deliverable: Tags, budget, quotas and cost report
checks: Cost centre tag applied by default

days.topic: OCI CLI, SDKs and Cloud Shell
days.lab_task: Script the creation and clean-up of a test environment with the CLI, list all instances across compartments with the Python SDK and run a script with instance principals.

days.topic: Infrastructure as Code with Resource Manager and Terraform
days.lab_task: Write Terraform for the VCN, instances and load balancer, run it as a Resource Manager stack, detect a manual change as drift and destroy and recreate the environment.
days.deliverable: Terraform code, stack and drift report

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Three-Tier Web Application on OCI
days.lab_task: Build a three-tier app for the case company with Terraform: compartments and policies, a VCN with private tiers, load-balanced instances, Autonomous Database, backups, alarms, budgets and tags, then demo a server failure.
days.deliverable: Terraform repository, architecture diagram and demo recording
checks: Stop a web server in the demo
Database reachable only from the app tier
Cost tags and budget in place
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one application

intermediate.summary: For cloud engineers and administrators running workloads on OCI. Covers hub-and-spoke networking with DRGs, FastConnect and VPN, OKE, the container registry and DevOps service, Functions and API Gateway, Streaming and Events, Cloud Guard and Security Zones, Vault, WAF and Bastion, database high availability, Exadata Database Service, data integration and GoldenGate, AI services and Generative AI, observability, autoscaling, disaster recovery, governance and the Architect Associate exam.
prerequisites: Builds networks, compute, storage and databases on OCI
outcomes: Design connected, secure networks and run containers and serverless apps
Secure tenancies with Cloud Guard, Vault, WAF and Bastion
Run highly available databases and data integration
Observe, scale, recover and govern workloads and pass the Architect Associate exam

days.topic: Hub-and-Spoke Networking with Dynamic Routing Gateways
days.lab_task: Build a hub VCN with a network firewall and two spoke VCNs attached to a DRG, route spoke traffic through the firewall and check paths with Network Path Analyzer.
days.deliverable: Network design, configuration and path analysis

days.topic: Hybrid Connectivity: FastConnect and Site-to-Site VPN
days.lab_task: Connect a simulated data centre with a redundant site-to-site VPN using BGP, fail one tunnel and confirm traffic continues.
checks: Both tunnels up with BGP sessions
VPN or FastConnect chosen with reasons

days.topic: Kubernetes with OCI Container Engine (OKE)
days.lab_task: Create an OKE cluster with VCN-native pod networking, deploy an app with an ingress, give pods access to object storage with workload identity and upgrade the cluster.
checks: Reach the app through the ingress
Read a bucket from a pod

days.topic: Container Registry and the OCI DevOps Service
subtopics: Deployment pipelines to OKE and instances
days.lab_task: Build an image with a DevOps build pipeline, scan it, push it to the registry and deploy to OKE with approval, then roll back a bad release.
days.deliverable: Pipelines, scan results and rollback evidence
checks: Image pushed with a version tag

days.topic: Serverless with OCI Functions and API Gateway
days.lab_task: Build a function that resizes images uploaded to a bucket, expose another function through API Gateway with authentication and rate limits.
checks: Call the API without a token

days.topic: Streaming, Events and Queues
days.lab_task: Send order events to OCI Streaming with a Kafka client, process them with a consumer, move logs to object storage with Service Connector Hub and use a queue for background jobs.

days.topic: Security Posture: Cloud Guard and Security Zones
days.lab_task: Turn on Cloud Guard, create a public bucket and an open security list to trigger problems, auto-remediate one and create a Security Zone that blocks public resources.
days.deliverable: Cloud Guard set-up, problems and Security Zone
checks: Create a public resource in the zone

days.topic: Vault, Keys and Secrets
subtopics: Customer-managed keys for storage and databases
days.lab_task: Create a vault and keys, encrypt a bucket and block volume with your key, store a database password as a secret read by an app and rotate the key.
checks: Read the secret from an app

days.topic: Web Application Firewall, Bastion and Network Security
subtopics: Zero trust packet routing in brief
days.lab_task: Protect the web app with WAF rules and rate limits, remove public SSH and use Bastion sessions, and test the protections.
days.deliverable: WAF policy, Bastion set-up and tests
checks: Session works with no public SSH

days.topic: Database High Availability: Data Guard and Autonomous Data Guard
days.lab_task: Add a Data Guard standby to a DB system and an Autonomous Data Guard peer in another region, switch over both and measure application downtime.

days.topic: Exadata Database Service on OCI
days.lab_task: Review an Exadata VM cluster set-up, create a pluggable database, scale OCPUs, plan patching and compare cost with Autonomous Database for a workload.
days.deliverable: Configuration notes, patch plan and cost comparison

days.topic: Data Integration and GoldenGate on OCI
days.lab_task: Replicate an on-premises table to Autonomous Database with OCI GoldenGate, build a Data Integration flow that loads a warehouse and run a Spark job in Data Flow.
days.deliverable: Replication, data flow and Spark job

days.topic: AI Services: Language, Vision, Speech and Document Understanding
days.lab_task: Extract fields from invoices with Document Understanding, classify ticket sentiment with Language and transcribe a call with Speech, all from a Python script.

days.topic: OCI Generative AI Service
days.lab_task: Build a RAG assistant with Generative AI Agents over product documents, compare two chat models and evaluate answers on 20 questions.

days.topic: Observability: Logging Analytics, APM and Monitoring
days.lab_task: Send app logs to Logging Analytics with a dashboard, trace a slow request with APM, add a synthetic test and review database capacity in Ops Insights.
checks: Errors shown on the log dashboard

days.topic: Autoscaling with Instance Pools and OKE
days.lab_task: Build an instance pool behind a load balancer with metric-based autoscaling, add scheduled scaling for business hours and autoscale pods and nodes in OKE.
days.deliverable: Pool configuration, scaling policies and test results
checks: Pool resizes at the set time
Nodes added by the cluster autoscaler

days.topic: Backup and Disaster Recovery with Full Stack DR
days.lab_task: Protect the three-tier app with Full Stack DR across two regions, run prechecks, perform a switchover drill and fail back.
checks: App running in the standby region within the target
App back in the primary region

days.topic: Governance: Tagging, Quotas and Organisation Management
days.lab_task: Set tag defaults and quotas for three teams with Terraform, review policies for excess access and produce a governance report.

days.topic: OCI Architect Associate Certification Preparation
days.lab_task: Take a timed practice exam, rebuild wrong answers in the tenancy, practise weak areas and take a second exam.
days.deliverable: Two practice scores and a weak-areas list

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Secure Containerised Platform on OCI
days.lab_task: Build a platform for the case company with hub-and-spoke networking, OKE with CI/CD, WAF and Bastion, Vault, Cloud Guard, a replicated database, an AI feature, autoscaling, observability and DR, then demo a regional switchover.
days.deliverable: Terraform repository, pipelines, dashboards and demo recording
checks: Run the switchover in the demo
Platform running in the second region
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one platform

advanced.summary: For cloud architects and senior engineers. Covers landing zones, multicloud with Oracle Database@Azure and interconnects, hybrid and dedicated regions, migration programmes, availability and DR architectures, zero trust security, compliance, FinOps, Kubernetes at scale, serverless architectures, data lakehouse design, AI infrastructure, performance engineering, GitOps automation, observability at scale, ERP workloads, sovereign cloud, troubleshooting and the Architect Professional exam.
outcomes: Design enterprise, multicloud and sovereign OCI architectures
Lead migrations of applications, databases and ERP systems
Secure, govern and optimise cost at scale

days.topic: OCI Landing Zones for Enterprise Tenancies
subtopics: CIS Landing Zone and Operating Entities landing zone
days.lab_task: Deploy a CIS landing zone with Terraform, review its compartments, policies and security services and extend it for a new business unit.
checks: New compartments and policies from code

days.topic: Multicloud with Oracle Database@Azure, @AWS and @Google Cloud
days.lab_task: Design a multicloud architecture with an Azure application and Oracle Database@Azure, plan networking and identity and compare cost and latency with keeping everything in one cloud.
objectives: Use Oracle Database in other clouds

days.topic: Hybrid and Dedicated Cloud: Cloud@Customer and Dedicated Region
days.lab_task: Choose hybrid options for a bank that must keep data on site, design the operating model and compare costs with public regions.
days.deliverable: Hybrid design, operating model and cost comparison
checks: Choice justified by residency and scale

days.topic: Migration Programmes to OCI
days.lab_task: Assess a sample estate, plan waves, migrate two VMware VMs with Oracle Cloud Migrations and a database with ZDM, and run a cutover rehearsal.
days.deliverable: Assessment, wave plan and migration evidence

days.topic: High Availability and Disaster Recovery Architectures
days.lab_task: Design active-passive and active-active versions of a payments app across regions, estimate RTO, RPO and cost and test active-active traffic steering.
days.deliverable: Two designs, estimates and test results
checks: RTO and RPO for each design

days.topic: Zero Trust Security Architecture on OCI
subtopics: Network segmentation and zero trust packet routing
days.lab_task: Redesign the platform's security with zero trust: remove network trust between tiers, use workload identities, encrypt with customer keys and monitor continuously, then review maturity.

days.topic: Compliance and Audit on OCI
subtopics: PCI DSS and HIPAA on OCI
days.lab_task: Map PCI DSS requirements to OCI services and controls, collect evidence from audit logs and Cloud Guard and run continuous CIS checks.
days.deliverable: Control mapping, evidence pack and check results
checks: Each requirement mapped to a control

days.topic: FinOps and Cost Optimisation on OCI
days.lab_task: Analyse a month of costs, right-size instances with flexible shapes, move data to cheaper tiers, plan commitments and report savings by compartment.

days.topic: Kubernetes at Scale on OKE
days.lab_task: Run a multi-tenant OKE cluster with policies, GitOps and separate node pools, upgrade it with no downtime and report cost by team.
days.deliverable: Cluster configuration, policies and cost report

days.topic: Serverless and Event-Driven Architectures on OCI
days.lab_task: Build an order pipeline with API Gateway, Functions, Queue and Streaming, handle failures with dead-letter queues and trace requests end to end.
checks: Message sent to the dead-letter queue

days.topic: Data Lakehouse on OCI
subtopics: Object storage as the data lake
days.lab_task: Build a lakehouse with raw data in object storage, Spark transformations in Data Flow, curated tables in Autonomous Data Warehouse, a catalogue and an Analytics Cloud report.

days.topic: AI Infrastructure on OCI: GPUs and Clusters
subtopics: Choosing between managed AI and own infrastructure
days.lab_task: Plan GPU infrastructure for fine-tuning a model, run a small training job on a GPU node in OKE and compare cost with the managed Generative AI service.
days.deliverable: Infrastructure plan, training run and cost comparison
checks: Job completes on the GPU node
Own infrastructure and managed service compared

days.topic: Performance Engineering on OCI
days.lab_task: Load test the app, tune storage performance levels and instance shapes, add OCI Cache and record each change's effect.
days.deliverable: Load test reports and tuning log

days.topic: Automation and GitOps for OCI
days.lab_task: Build an infrastructure pipeline with plan reviews, policy checks and drift detection, promote changes from test to production and offer a self-service template.

days.topic: Observability at Enterprise Scale
days.lab_task: Centralise logs from three tenancies, define SLOs for key services, connect Grafana and run a monthly health review.
days.deliverable: Logging design, SLOs, dashboards and review notes

days.topic: Running Oracle Applications on OCI: E-Business Suite, JD Edwards and PeopleSoft
subtopics: Why run Oracle applications on OCI
High availability and DR for applications
days.lab_task: Design an E-Business Suite deployment on OCI with HA and DR, clone an environment with EBS Cloud Manager and plan patching windows.
days.deliverable: Architecture, clone evidence and patch plan

days.topic: Sovereign Cloud and Data Residency
subtopics: Key control and external key management
days.lab_task: Design a sovereign deployment for a public sector client with keys held outside OCI, residency controls and local operations, and review it against requirements.
checks: Data unreadable without the external key
Data and backups stay in the region

days.topic: Troubleshooting Production OCI Issues
days.lab_task: Diagnose five injected issues (a wrong route, a missing policy, a full boot volume, a hit service limit and a database wallet problem), fix each and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review
checks: Path Analyzer shows a good path

days.topic: OCI Architect Professional Certification Preparation
days.lab_task: Take a timed professional practice exam, discuss scenario answers with a partner, practise weak areas and take a second exam.
days.deliverable: Two practice scores and a weak-areas list

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise OCI Architecture
days.lab_task: Design and deliver OCI for a case enterprise: a landing zone, multicloud database access, migrated workloads, a lakehouse, zero trust security, FinOps reporting and DR, then run a regional drill and present to an architecture board.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, Terraform code, drill report and board presentation
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one architecture
